title: Social Dimensions of Climate Change in Solomon Islands
methodology: Publisher findings from mixed qualitative and quantitative community research.
limitations: Publisher synthesis, not the complete report or a causal evaluation.

title: Inclusive Governance of Natural Resources
limitations: Design commitments and intended benefits are not verified outcomes.

title: Climate change, conflict and peacebuilding in Solomon Islands
methodology: Authors' publisher summary of a contextual peacebuilding paper.
limitations: Month-only publication date; qualitative potential risks, not event attribution.

title: Implementation Completion and Results Report: Community Resilience to Climate and Disaster Risk Project (P112613)
methodology: World Bank completion evaluation using project monitoring, beneficiary survey, site visits and economic analysis.
limitations: M&E was rated modest; the 103-person survey was non-representative, and remote-site visits and COVID-19 limited field coverage.

title: Community-based adaptation to climate change in villages of Western Province, Solomon Islands
organization: Marine Pollution Bulletin; Britt Basel, Gillian Goby and Johanna Johnson; hosted by SPREP
temporal_coverage: Community fieldwork and adaptation workshops in 2017; article published in 2020.
methodology: Participatory workshops, interviews and semi-quantitative vulnerability assessment in two Rendova communities.
limitations: Two purposively selected communities had existing leadership and conservation ties; not representative.

title: Climate-related disasters and temperature extremes are not associated with conflict risk in Pacific Island countries
organization: Environment and Security; Tobias Ide, Ore Koren and Luke Derrick
temporal_coverage: Geocoded conflict and climate-event dataset for 2012-2020; article first published online 2026-01-22.
methodology: Original geocoded social-conflict dataset and panel regressions at 0.5-degree cell-year scale across three Pacific countries, with contextual controls and robustness tests.
limitations: Observational panel; Methods specify2012-2020 but Discussion describes13years/936observations. No direct mechanism test or coverage of organized armed groups.

title: Community-Led Climate Adaptation Projects Strengthen Resilience Across Solomon Islands
organization: United Nations Development Programme, Pacific Office
temporal_coverage: Community-Based Adaptation Phase III investments 2022-2026; closing workshop in June 2026; page dated 2026-08-25.
methodology: Official UNDP programme-completion announcement summarizing community project outputs and a June 2026 closing workshop.
limitations: No evaluation design, baseline or disaggregated beneficiary counts are provided; reported benefits are UNDP's summary, not independent impact estimates.

title: Solomon Islands Advances National Climate Adaptation Planning
organization: Solomon Islands Government, My SIG Services Portal
temporal_coverage: NAP formulation workshop held 2026-10-20; CRVA and SIIVA assessment processes reported as current in October 2026.
methodology: Government announcement summarizing the NAP workshop, the national Climate Risk and Vulnerability Assessment, and SIIVA work in two provinces.
limitations: The announcement describes planning and assessment scope, not underlying CRVA or SIIVA findings or evaluated adaptation outcomes.
